objective: Keep one evidence-backed Design question visible and resumable across terminal and chat while producing a complete request for the existing stateless deterministic CLI.

evidence_anchors.contract: stateless deterministic CLI and interactive one-question clarification
evidence-backed one-question cadence and immediate structured decision trace
current repair frontier and no-authority execution boundary
two-source separation, monotonic Design chain, and evidence ceiling

proposed_session_records.name: SESSION.json
proposed_session_records.purpose: session identity, target, format version, state, and revision

proposed_session_records.name: DECISIONS.jsonl
proposed_session_records.purpose: structured selected answer, rejected alternatives, rationale, and affected targets

proposed_session_records.name: EVIDENCE.jsonl
proposed_session_records.purpose: exact source refs, digests, observation state, and freshness classification

proposed_session_records.name: EVIDENCE-COVERAGE.json
proposed_session_records.purpose: declared historical-evidence boundary and denominator, total discovered-ref classification, coverage digests, evidence gaps, and bidirectional source traceability

proposed_session_records.name: CHECKPOINT.json
proposed_session_records.purpose: last complete session revision, evidence snapshot, active question, and next safe action

proposed_session_records.name: DRAFT-REQUEST.json
proposed_session_records.purpose: incrementally assembled complete request for the existing deterministic CLI

historical_evidence_coverage_contract.denominator_rule: every evidence reference discovered under the declared boundary and discovery rules

classification_requirements.stale: newer or missing identity that prevents current use
classification_requirements.unavailable: failed locator or access reason and affected targets
classification_requirements.conflicting: all known incompatible refs and unresolved issue

traceability.source_to_question: every included source identifies all canonical question revisions it informed
traceability.question_to_source: every evidence-backed canonical question identifies its source refs
traceability.source_to_draft_field: every included source identifies all draft request fields it supports
traceability.draft_field_to_source: every evidence-backed draft request field identifies its source refs
traceability.unused_included_source_policy: remain visible and classified rather than silently dropped

loss_policy.required_result: classify the expected ref as unavailable, record an evidence gap, and identify affected questions and draft fields
loss_policy.forbidden_result: silent reconstruction from inference, partial summary, memory, or unbound transcript

session_invariants: At most one question is active.
The canonical question and checkpoint are durable before either surface renders the question.
A decision binds the exact active question ID, question revision, and expected session revision.
Terminal and chat render the same canonical question record.
Raw transcript content is never decision authority.
Evidence completeness is stated only relative to the declared selected boundary.
Every discovered denominator ref has exactly one current coverage classification.
Included sources are traceable to questions and draft fields, and evidence-backed questions and draft fields trace back to sources.
Compaction, thread loss, truncation, or unreadable history remains a visible unavailable-evidence gap and is never silently reconstructed.
Interruptions preserve the last complete checkpoint and never synthesize an answer.
A stale or conflicting answer fails closed without overwriting the canonical record.
Relevant evidence drift marks affected questions and decisions stale and invalidates dependent draft fields.
Finalize cannot manufacture owner approval or independent evidence.

resume: verify session format and target identity
recompute and compare boundary, denominator, classification, and traceability digests
render the same active question or reopen the earliest stale dependency
conflict: reject non-active or stale question revisions
preserve competing submissions as visible conflict evidence
require explicit reconciliation for semantically different answers
staleness: detect boundary, denominator, classification, or traceability changes
mark affected questions and decisions stale
finalize_blocks_on: required evidence represented only by a compaction or thread-loss gap
missing required owner or independent evidence

post_fix_resume_criteria: Fresh passing validation covers the exact post-fix Design producer bytes and declared real consumers.
The Design process definition and deterministic CLI contracts are re-read from that validated baseline.
Changed stages, request fields, evidence identities, and authority boundaries are reconciled explicitly.
Session location, record schemas, chat bridge ownership, conflict policy, historical-evidence boundary ownership, coverage and traceability rules, privacy policy, and retention policy are decided.
A bounded implementation unit, acceptance checks, and independent review are separately authorized.
open_design_decisions: chat bridge ownership and transport contract
answer normalization and explicit confirmation rules
coverage classification, digest, and bidirectional traceability contract
privacy, retention, export, and cleanup policy
final request handoff to deterministic CLI
